# GitHub Copilot instructions

Read the repository-root `AGENTS.md` before making changes; it is authoritative.

Use only root `Project X.html` as the canonical game source. Do not edit, merge from, or restore legacy HTML copies. Preserve existing gameplay and save compatibility. Favor gradual, reversible modularization over a full rewrite. Preserve existing assets and test affected flows. Follow all requirements in `AGENTS.md`.
